**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

§ 28.1 selects New York law with CISG excluded, and § 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/forum objections — exactly our preferred GOVLAW position. A document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seat risk. The mutual injunctive-relief carve-out and the § 28.3 executive escalation (which expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings) do not displace the New York forum. No redline proposed.
